time_convention: t = frame / 24; frame = round(t * 24); frame 0 at t = 0
pixel_convention: x right, y DOWN, origin top-left of the 1080x1920 frame, full resolution

camera.motion: static (frame 49 vs frame 0 background abs diff mean 0.25/255, p99.9 = 4)
camera.view: near-frontal, roughly horizontal camera; the cup's underside shows when it is high in the frame and the lid's top surface shows when it is low, so the camera sits at roughly mid-frame height
camera.floor_seam_note: faint horizontal brightness change where the floor meets the seamless backdrop (gradient max at y 1534-1535 in every column); the floor is the lighter band below it

cup.description: disposable coffee cup: red body with a tan/beige sleeve band and a light grey/white lid; the only object in the scene
cup.reference_point: cx, cy = centre of the full-cup bbox (lid top to cup bottom, x-extent including the lid rim); best image proxy for the rigid object's origin
cup.motion: falls straight down (x stays at 575-577 px), no visible rotation, lands upright on the floor, short squash/stretch rebound, then rests

in_flight_size_px.height_bbox: 173 (f6) shrinking to 150 (f15-18): perspective, the underside ellipse is seen high in the frame

cup.apparent_size_change: width constant (+-2 px), so the cup stays at one depth (planar 2D motion); height changes only from the viewing angle and from the landing squash/stretch

floor.description: light beige floor / seamless backdrop (cyclorama); seam at y about 1534

cup_shadow.description: soft grey contact shadow under the cup once it is near or on the floor (frames about 17-49); not part of the cup and excluded from the cup's extents

events.name: cup already falling when first visible (released before the clip or above the frame)
events.note: bottom edge appears at y = 0-1; it has already moved down about 29 px by frame 3

events.name: impact with floor (first contact frame)
events.note: contact happens between frames 18 and 19; extrapolating the bottom edge puts it about 0.3 frame after f18 (t about 0.76 s)

events.name: stretch / rebound (bottom stays on the floor, top rises about 14 px)
settle
events.note: height 149 then 143; at rest from frame 24

events.name: at rest
events.note: only +-1 px jitter in the bbox after this
